answer: The island test I would run is Admired bonesetter certificate with bonesetters society attestation: a certificate the society renews after splint audits, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. The economics flip: the network spends pennies verifying, the attacker spends real money proving, and the pigment of that gap is the whole defence in one line. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the jade of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
